A gentle winding river scene with two coherent banks, one broad tree, two large stones and distant low hills, all contours spacious and no texture.
A compact self-contained vignette wholly within 12 percent margins. Spacious simple contours. No extra pebbles, grass sprigs, clouds, sand stippling, bark marks, or repeated decorative texture.
